title: •Civil Disorder
caption: •Civil Disorder (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. You may not play Rebel Barrier. Senators are deploy +2. Whenever you initiate a battle, may retrieve your topmost non-{lightsaber}, non-{maintenance} character. May place the top card of your Reserve Deck in Lost Pile to place a combat card in owner’s Lost Pile. {alter}
lore: “Attention. This is Lando Calrissian. The Empire has taken control of the city. I advise everyone to leave before more Imperial troops arrive.”

notes: Unique. Two inline icons in 'non-[black square, green blade], non-[gold spoked wheel] character' → {lightsaber} and {maintenance} per this run's instructions (the stub expands them as 'non-warrior, non-pilot'). Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}; curly apostrophe in owner’s. The wiki's default 'Civil Disorder' page is the printed archive face (card_uid 5_20o; 'Civil Disorder (Original)' is the same face); the 745 px CC-L-civildisorder.gif is the D-E1 errata face (game text 'Deploy on opponent's side of table…') — downloaded to src/vs6/06-CC-L-civildisorder.gif for art only, the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Top half identical on both. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around the whole quote (wiki has straight single quotes). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
